milestones.name: Foundation and platform
milestones.goal: Cargo workspace, Linux paths, logging, crash reports, platform traits, build identity.
exit: you can build and launch an empty Kurobayomi window from the workspace
a forced panic writes a crash report file under the Linux data directory

milestones.name: Preferences and databases
milestones.goal: Preference store with TOML backend, manga and anime SQLite schemas, repositories.
exit: you can change a setting and find it again after restart
the manga and anime databases are created and migrated on first launch

milestones.name: Domain, HTTP and source contract
milestones.goal: Domain models and interactors, HTTP client with rate limits and cookies, source traits, source manager, stubs, frozen ids.
exit: domain tests pass headless
the HTTP client passes fixture tests with rate limits enabled
frozen source id golden vectors pass

milestones.name: Local reading and playing
milestones.goal: Local source for manga and anime, image pipeline and cover cache, reader core and viewers, player core and controls on libmpv.
exit: you can open a local CBZ or folder and page through it
you can play a local video file with mpv and your position is saved

milestones.name: Daily-driver shell
milestones.goal: App shell and navigation, library, entry details for manga and anime, updates and history, P0 settings, theme, i18n, desktop integration.
exit: you can navigate every P0 route from the sidebar
every P0 settings row persists across restart
your library shows local entries with categories

milestones.name: First live source and browse
milestones.goal: Extension strategy, first built-in live source, extension manager, browse, global search for manga and anime.
exit: you can browse, open details, read chapters and watch episodes from the first live source
you can search across installed sources

milestones.name: Downloads
milestones.goal: Manga and anime downloads, shared queue, download storage layout and notifications.
exit: a queued chapter download completes and reads offline
a queued episode download completes and plays offline

milestones.name: Library updates and notifications
milestones.goal: Library update jobs, scheduling, restrictions, notifications, updater and library export.
exit: the library refreshes on schedule and reports new chapters and episodes
a desktop notification appears for new items

milestones.name: Tracking core and AniList
milestones.goal: Tracker framework, OAuth plumbing, track domain and UI, AniList tracker.
exit: you can log in to AniList, bind an entry, and push progress

milestones.name: Other trackers
milestones.goal: MyAnimeList, Kitsu, Shikimori, Bangumi, MangaUpdates, Simkl, and enhanced trackers Kavita, Komga, Suwayomi, Jellyfin.
exit: each shipped tracker can log in, bind and sync progress

milestones.name: Backup, restore and migration
milestones.goal: Backup file format, creators, auto-backup, restore, validators, legacy handling, in-app migration of Aniyomi data.
exit: a round trip of a real Aniyomi backup file restores library, categories, history and progress

milestones.name: Long-tail polish (P2)
milestones.goal: P2 features and polish across all areas.
exit: every P2 task is either done or explicitly deferred with a recorded reason

milestones.name: Android-only decisions and replacements (P3)
milestones.goal: P3 tasks: Android-only obsolete features, their Linux replacement or drop decision, and the Windows spike.
exit: every P3 task states its replacement or drop decision and the user-visible loss
